abilities.text: Deploy this Goon into ranks of opponent players Goons instead of your own. If this Goon is destroyed while under a players control, instead of destroying it, remove all wind from it and controlling player must destroy one of their Goons in place of surfer

goons.flavor_text: You gotta feel kinda bad for him. It's not like he has a homeworld to go back to.

abilities.name: PROFESSIONAL RESULTS
abilities.text: During the turn Goon exits stealth node and returns to play, distribute X + X * S wind to players Goons as you like. S is number of continuous turns spent in stealth mode prior to exiting.
